statement: In the beets web plugin (beetsplug/web/__init__.py), QueryConverter splits URL queries on '/' and turns backslashes into os.sep, so path queries can use backslashes as path separators in URLs. This conversion also breaks regex queries that contain backslashes.
quote: The backslash replacement was added so that path queries could work in URLs (since `/` is used as a query separator, and Flask can't include `/` in a path segment).

statement: Beets query-string parsing, including the `field::pattern` regex syntax, is implemented in beets/dbcore/queryparse.py.
There is no beets/types.py module, so path-typed fields such as Album 'artpath' (PathType) are defined through types used in beets/library.py.
